what: Which class an Xbox function without one probably belongs to, for functions the project has no class for.
how: Each Xbox function here is paired with a PC function (reports/pairing_xb_pc_study.json), and scarface-p3d's coverage table (aap, MIT; re/coverage_funcs.txt) attributes that PC function to a class. 'by' is how it did: vtable (the function is in the class's virtual table), ctor/vtref (it writes the class's virtual table pointer: a constructor or destructor), callers (every caller is a method of the class, so it is used by the class and may be a helper, not a member).
check: Where the project already knew an Xbox function's class, the 'vtable' attribution named the same class for 1,312 of 1,509 pairs (the rest are mostly a base class against a derived one); 'callers' agreed for 7 of 26, so read those as 'used by', not 'member of'. A lead to check against the code, not a fact.
